values.meaning: passive bonus on-hit magic damage as percent of target's missing health
values.quote: {{as|3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}}

values.meaning: passive triggers against enemies below this max-health threshold
values.quote: against enemies below {{sti|health|{{as|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: The passive on-hit magic damage only procs against enemies whose current health is below 30% of their maximum health.
mechanics.quote: '''Ekko's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}} against enemies below {{sti|health|{{as|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: The passive can proc on the attack that also triggers the final stack of Z-Drive Resonance if that attack reduces the target below the 30% threshold.
mechanics.quote: The passive will proc with the attack that triggers the final stack of {{ai|Z-Drive Resonance|Ekko|Resonance}} if it reduces a target's health below the 30% threshold.

mechanics.claim: Ekko gains a shield only when he walks into the deployed chronosphere before it expires, detonating it.
mechanics.quote: If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|stun}} enemies within

mechanics.claim: Ekko can trigger the shield-granting detonation even while untargetable (e.g. during Chronobreak's dash), but not while resurrecting.
mechanics.quote: '''Ekko''' can detonate the expansion even while {{tip|untargetable}} (i.e. {{ais|Chronobreak|Ekko}} dash), but not if he is {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}}.
